style: Read the lines below as Nika, a warm, cheerful, natural American English female voice narrating short videos of a kids' learning app for parents on Instagram: friendly, gently upbeat, clear, smiling, never robotic, never shouting. Make a clear pause of about one second after every line. Read only the lines:
lines: Pizza night, little chef style! Dough, sauce, toppings, oven, slice. Following steps, one at a time, is a real early learning skill. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Fire truck bath time! Soap, scrub, rinse and shine. Your little helper makes the fire truck sparkle again. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Uh oh, the car broke down! Tow it, fix it, paint it, and it's back on the road. Tiny mechanics, big problem solvers. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Can your little one find the number nine? Catch the right balloons and fill the truck. Number practice that flies by! Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
What's inside the egg? Every finished game earns a star, and five stars crack open a surprise sticker! Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Puzzle time! Drag the pieces and watch the smiley bus appear. Fifty-six pictures to finish. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Shapes on the move! Stars, hearts and ovals ride the Shape Express. Which wagon gets the heart? Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Can you find the pairs? Flip two cards and remember where each truck is hiding. Great for focus! Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
